cubic_cover.label: Odd-field cubic genus-three branch
cubic_cover.test: Exact model label and necessary conductor-depth screen in the recorded cubic domain.

elliptic_quotient_prym.label: Elliptic quotient and complement
elliptic_quotient_prym.test: Cover geometry, complementary factor, computable Jacobian projection and kernel on the selected subgroup.

ghs_descent.label: Binary GHS lower-field route
ghs_descent.test: Magic number, projected genus, base-field degree and transport-size screen; a cover equation and subgroup map remain separate.

hyperelliptic_divisor_decomposition.label: Divisor factor-base decomposition
hyperelliptic_divisor_decomposition.test: Destination H, divisor encoding, frozen factor base, natural full-relation yield, rank, final linear algebra and target descent.

hyperelliptic_high_genus.label: High-genus smoothness route
hyperelliptic_high_genus.test: Exact destination genus and field, factor-base degree bound, natural-query smoothness and complete cost.

hyperelliptic_large_prime.label: Large-prime divisor relations
hyperelliptic_large_prime.test: Partial-relation yield, verified recombination graph, rank, final linear algebra and target descent.

jacobian_isogeny_decomposition.label: Jacobian factorization
jacobian_isogeny_decomposition.test: Weil polynomial over the destination field, factorization, explicit projection and selected-subgroup image.

quadratic_cover.label: Odd-field quadratic genus-three branch
quadratic_cover.test: Exact model label and necessary model conditions in the recorded quadratic domain.

route_cost.label: Complete route cost
route_cost.test: Cover search, map construction, divisor or factor solve, target descent and independent replay against the same-group reference.

same_field_cover.label: Same-field hyperelliptic cover
same_field_cover.test: Exact H to E equation, genus, map degree and declared field; same-field geometry does not test subfield descent.

subgroup_transport.label: Selected-subgroup transport
subgroup_transport.test: Exact selected order, generator and target, map images, kernel intersection and scalar compatibility.
